Scope narrowed by SPEC 0.4.6 D12/D15 (tar retired, f4bf7e0b2); no ADR covers export. Change: export is read-only (delete `_refresh_branches` and its `_store.update`); soft (default) `.dadaia/dist/spec-contexts.json` schema v2: contexts (slug, name, state, main repo url, associated [{slug,url}]), the exact `dadaia_version`, the harnesses of `.dadaia/states/harness_profile.json`, per repo its snapshots (tags portable; bundles listed as not portable, warning exit); hard `dadaia export --hard` -> one `.tar.gz` in `.dadaia/dist/` = soft + bundles of every open worktree and every bundle of `.dadaia/snapshots/`, content passed through the denylist+baseline scan (a hit refuses); never the denylist, credentials, sessions or the install ledger. The `dist` zone (`core/workspace_layout.py:194`) admits both. The artifact reader is hardened: an incomplete record -> DadaiaError, a null url refused. ADD justified: the hard artifact is the one carrier of local-only work (a public repo's bundle never leaves by git). It does not resurrect the retired tar pipeline's bug class (import-extracts-manifest-to-root): one archive of fixed members (the soft JSON and `snapshots/<ctx>/<repo>/<name>.bundle`); every member validated before extraction (no absolute path, no `..`, no link, nothing outside that list); the JSON is read in memory and extraction is confined to `.dadaia/snapshots/`, never the root. Done when: soft and hard validate against their schemas; a hard export with a planted secret is refused. Files: features/export/service.py, cli/commands/export.py, core/models/spec_context.py (EXPORT_SCHEMA_VERSION), core/workspace_layout.py (dist zone), the artifact reader, public/schemas (two new schemas). Bugs (class guarded): import-extracts-manifest-to-root (a restored archive lands outside its zone), import-export-workspace-flag-re-resolves-through-ancestor-walk (export half), context-create-admits-uncloneable-empty-url (the null-url class). ADR 0175 (proposed; supersedes SPEC 0.4.6 D12/D15 for the hard export).

Dev-tooling is a repo-declared, language-neutral class (for example a dadaia-dev-tooling attribute in .gitattributes, the ADR 0183 seam), never 'outside the shipped package'; unknown surfaces stay out of recurrence counts. evidence_seam node matching covers parametrized and class-qualified ids. docs/bug-ledger-lessons.md is derived from the ## Bugs review under P-29.
